raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

The Qwen3.8-27B cookbook page has no AMD recipe. AMD publishes an MXFP4 checkpoint for CDNA4, `amd/Qwen3.8-27B-Quark-AWQ-MXFP4`: the language model is MXFP4 W4A4 and the vision encoder stays bf16. It runs on a single MI355X.

Rebased onto current `main` (the conflict was the Xeon CPU cell added in #40092; both cells are kept, and the DSPARK disable rule now covers Xeon and MI355X).

## Modifications

- `qwen3.8-27b.jsx`:
  - adds `mi355x` hardware and an `MXFP4` quantization option;
  - maps the model name to the AMD checkpoint;
  - sets the ROCm docker image `lmsysorg/sglang-rocm:v0.5.22-rocm724-mi35x-20261021`, the image the AMD nightly performance config for this checkpoint uses.
- New `mi355x` / `mxfp4` cell, single GPU like the other cells. Flags follow the AMD nightly performance config for this checkpoint at TP1:
  - `SGLANG_USE_AITER=1`, `--quantization quark`, `--attention-backend aiter`;
  - `--kv-cache-dtype fp8_e4m3`, `--mem-fraction-static 0.9`, `--chunked-prefill-size 16384`;
  - `--cuda-graph-backend-prefill breakable`. On ROCm the prefill CUDA graph is off unless a backend is set (`default_prefill_backend()` returns `disabled` off CUDA). Turning it on was measured on MI355X at +9.5% image-request throughput (TTFT -16%) at TP1 and +2.5% at TP2. It passed GSM8K and MMMU checks but is not bit-exact against eager prefill, which the page says;
  - the qwen3 reasoning and tool-call parsers.

  The cell still reports **Final Verification In Progress** until the full GSM8K run for this exact cell is in.
- The DSPARK overlay is disabled on MI355X: it pins a FlashInfer draft attention backend, which ROCm does not ship.
- Page text:
  - MI355X added to the supported cards;
  - an MI355X note on the AITER/FP8-KV setup and the breakable prefill graph, and a recommendation to add `--mm-enable-dp-encoder` at `--tp-size 2`, so that each GPU encodes whole images instead of splitting every vision layer across both GPUs;
  - an optional TP2 setting, collapsed by default: INT4 QuickReduce for large prefill all-reduces (`ROCM_QUICK_REDUCE_QUANTIZATION=INT4` with `AITER_CUSTOM_AR_MAX_SIZE=8388608`, so all-reduces above 8 MiB leave the AITER custom all-reduce for QuickReduce). Measured +14% image-request throughput (TTFT -18.7%) at TP2. It is lossy, so the page marks it optional and gives its accuracy.

## Accuracy Tests

MI355X, with the breakable prefill graph and, at TP2, INT4 QuickReduce enabled:

| Eval | Score |
|---|---|
| GSM8K (TP2) | 0.957 |
| GPQA (TP2) | 0.813 |
| MMMU | 0.359 |

Pending: full GSM8K (1319 questions, `run_eval`) for the TP1 cell exactly as rendered.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

MI355X, image-serving throughput, each change against the same setup without it:

| Change | TP | Throughput | TTFT |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--cuda-graph-backend-prefill breakable` | 1 | +9.5% | -16% |
| `--cuda-graph-backend-prefill breakable` | 2 | +2.5% | |
| INT4 QuickReduce, 8 MiB custom AR cutoff (optional) | 2 | +14% | -18.7% |

## Checks

- `node docs/scripts/check_cookbook_configs.mjs`: OK
- `node --test docs/scripts/tests/*.test.mjs`: 52 passed
- `mint validate`: build validation passed
- `pre-commit run` on the changed files: passed

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [ ] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [x] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

@@ -1,6 +1,6 @@
 ---
 title: Qwen3.8-27B
-description: "Deploy Qwen3.8-27B with SGLang — dense hybrid GDN vision-language model with BF16/FP8/NVFP4 W4A4 checkpoints and in-checkpoint MTP, single-GPU on H200, RTX PRO 6000, RTX 5090 and DGX Spark."
+description: "Deploy Qwen3.8-27B with SGLang — dense hybrid GDN vision-language model with BF16/FP8/NVFP4 W4A4 checkpoints and in-checkpoint MTP, single-GPU on H200, RTX PRO 6000, RTX 5090, DGX Spark and AMD MI355X."
 ---
 
 ## Deployment
@@ -40,7 +40,7 @@ For how to launch the image, see [Install → Method 3: Using Docker](../../../d
 
 </Accordion>
 
-Pick your card + checkpoint precision to generate the launch command. The model runs single-GPU on every supported card — H200, RTX PRO 6000, RTX 5090 and DGX Spark — and ships one operating point.
+Pick your card + checkpoint precision to generate the launch command. The model runs single-GPU on every supported card — H200, RTX PRO 6000, RTX 5090, DGX Spark and AMD MI355X — and ships one operating point.
 
 <Note>
 `--mamba-full-memory-ratio` is the one sizing flag that matters for throughput
@@ -65,6 +65,39 @@ import { Qwen38MambaRatioCalculator } from "/src/snippets/_qwen38_mamba_ratio_ca
   and acceptance-length numbers were not re-taken in that sweep.
 </Note>
 
+<Note>
+  **AMD MI355X** serves the AMD Quark MXFP4 checkpoint
+  (`amd/Qwen3.8-27B-Quark-AWQ-MXFP4`) with the ROCm image, the AITER kernels
+  (`SGLANG_USE_AITER=1`, `--attention-backend aiter`) and an FP8 KV cache.
+  The recipe also sets `--cuda-graph-backend-prefill breakable`: on ROCm the
+  prefill CUDA graph is off unless a backend is chosen, and turning it on
+  raised image-request throughput by 9.5% at TP1 (TTFT -16%) and by 2.5% at
+  TP2. It passed the GSM8K and MMMU accuracy checks but is not bit-exact
+  against eager prefill; drop the flag if you need that.
+
+  To split one server across two GPUs (`--tp-size 2`) for lower latency, also
+  pass `--mm-enable-dp-encoder`: each GPU then encodes whole images with the
+  full vision encoder instead of splitting every vision layer across both GPUs.
+</Note>
+
+<Accordion title="Optional on MI355X TP2: INT4 QuickReduce for large prefill all-reduces">
+
+At `--tp-size 2`, large prefill all-reduces can run through ROCm QuickReduce
+with INT4 quantization. `AITER_CUSTOM_AR_MAX_SIZE` lowers the AITER custom
+all-reduce cutoff to 8 MiB, so messages above it go to QuickReduce instead;
+smaller (decode) all-reduces keep the full-precision custom all-reduce.
+
+```bash Extra environment
+export ROCM_QUICK_REDUCE_QUANTIZATION=INT4
+export AITER_CUSTOM_AR_MAX_SIZE=8388608
+```
+
+Measured on MI355X at TP2: image-request throughput +14% (TTFT -18.7%).
+QuickReduce INT4 is lossy, so check accuracy on your own workload before you
+enable it. With it on, the scores were GSM8K 0.957, GPQA 0.813 and MMMU 0.359.
+
+</Accordion>
+
 ### Mamba ratio calculator
 
 <Qwen38MambaRatioCalculator />

@@ -15,7 +15,7 @@
 export const config = {
   modelName: "Qwen3.8-27B",
 
-  supportedHardware: ["h200", "rtx6000", "rtx5090", "dgx-spark", "gb300", "xeon"],
+  supportedHardware: ["h200", "rtx6000", "rtx5090", "dgx-spark", "gb300", "xeon", "mi355x"],
 
   // RTX PRO 6000 and RTX 5090 (SM120 / Blackwell Desktop) are workstation and
   // consumer cards, not datacenter GPUs, so they are not in the shared catalog.
@@ -62,6 +62,10 @@ export const config = {
       // to bf16 here rather than fp8_e4m3; the cells pin fp8_e4m3 explicitly,
       // which makes the launch command and the KV pool identical either way.
       { id: "nvfp4-nvidia",    label: "NVFP4-NVIDIA"    },
+      // AMD's Quark export for CDNA4 (MI355X): MXFP4 W4A4 language model,
+      // vision encoder kept in bf16. OCP MXFP4, not NVFP4 -- only the
+      // mi355x cell serves it.
+      { id: "mxfp4",           label: "MXFP4"           },
     ] },
     { id: "nodes", title: "Nodes", options: [
       { id: "single", label: "Single Node" },
@@ -137,11 +141,15 @@ export const config = {
           // EAGLE. No --min-free-slots-delay: at --max-running-requests 1 it
           // is a strict no-op, and its real semantic (disable the delayer)
           // would silently bite anyone raising concurrency to 8+.
-          disabled: (sel) => sel.hw === "xeon" ||
+          // Off on MI355X: the row pins a FlashInfer draft attention backend,
+          // which ROCm does not ship.
+          disabled: (sel) => sel.hw === "xeon" || sel.hw === "mi355x" ||
             (sel.hw === "rtx5090" && !String(sel.quant).startsWith("nvfp4")),
           disableReason: (sel) => sel.hw === "xeon"
             ? "Xeon only supports no speculative decoding"
-            : "On the 32GB RTX 5090 the DSpark draft model only fits on top of the NVFP4 weights",
+            : sel.hw === "mi355x"
+              ? "DSpark's FlashInfer draft attention backend is not available on ROCm"
+              : "On the 32GB RTX 5090 the DSpark draft model only fits on top of the NVFP4 weights",
           stripPrefixes: (sel) =>
             sel.hw === "rtx5090"
               ? ["--mem-fraction-static", "--mamba-full-memory-ratio",
@@ -343,6 +351,7 @@ export const config = {
     "default|nvfp4-bf16-head": "RadixArk/Qwen3.8-27B-NVFP4-BF16-LMHead",
     "default|nvfp4-fp4-head":  "RadixArk/Qwen3.8-27B-NVFP4",
     "default|nvfp4-nvidia":    "nvidia/Qwen3.8-27B-NVFP4",
+    "default|mxfp4":           "amd/Qwen3.8-27B-Quark-AWQ-MXFP4",
   },
 
   placeholders: {
@@ -393,6 +402,9 @@ export const config = {
     rtx5090: "lmsysorg/sglang:latest",
     "dgx-spark": "lmsysorg/sglang:latest",
     gb300:   "lmsysorg/sglang:latest",
+    // gfx950 build; the generic image is CUDA-only. Same tag as the AMD
+    // nightly performance config for this checkpoint.
+    mi355x:  "lmsysorg/sglang-rocm:v0.5.22-rocm724-mi35x-20261021",
   },
 
   github: {
@@ -1038,5 +1050,38 @@ export const config = {
         "--port {{PORT}}",
       ],
     },
+    {
+      // MI355X 288GB, AMD Quark MXFP4 (W4A4 language model, bf16 vision
+      // encoder). SGLANG_USE_AITER selects the AITER MXFP4 GEMM, attention,
+      // norm and rope kernels; the ROCm image sets it, a bare-pip host does
+      // not. The flags follow the AMD nightly performance config for this
+      // checkpoint at TP1, plus the breakable prefill CUDA graph: on HIP the
+      // prefill graph is off unless a backend is set
+      // (cuda_graph_config.default_prefill_backend), and turning it on was
+      // measured at +9.5% image throughput (-16% TTFT) at TP1 and +2.5% at
+      // TP2. It was accuracy-checked (GSM8K, MMMU) but is not bit-exact
+      // against eager prefill. The full GSM8K run for this exact cell is
+      // still outstanding, so the envelope reports in-progress.
+      match: { hw: "mi355x", variant: "default", quant: "mxfp4", nodes: "single" },
+      verified: false,
+      verificationStatus: "in-progress",
+      env: [
+        "SGLANG_USE_AITER=1",
+      ],
+      flags: [
+        "--trust-remote-code",
+        "--model-path {{MODEL_NAME}}",
+        "--quantization quark",
+        "--kv-cache-dtype fp8_e4m3",
+        "--mem-fraction-static 0.9",
+        "--attention-backend aiter",
+        "--chunked-prefill-size 16384",
+        "--cuda-graph-backend-prefill breakable",
+        "--reasoning-parser qwen3",
+        "--tool-call-parser qwen3_coder",
+        "--host {{HOST_IP}}",
+        "--port {{PORT}}",
+      ],
+    },
   ],
 };
